$$
\int \sin{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "3fa4f0a8-a5a5-599b-b592-922d02da7a32" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x + 3$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=4.
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \sin{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=- \cos{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Integrate with respect to $u$:

$$
\frac{1}{4}\left(\int \sin{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=- \frac{\cos{\left(u \right)}}{4}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
- \frac{\cos{\left(4 x + 3 \right)}}{4}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "3fa4f0a8-a5a5-599b-b592-922d02da7a32" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "3fa4f0a8-a5a5-599b-b592-922d02da7a32" :question/answer-fields "f4725154-97d7-5a06-956a-ad97366aaa54"] [:db/ensure "3fa4f0a8-a5a5-599b-b592-922d02da7a32" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "3fa4f0a8-a5a5-599b-b592-922d02da7a32"] [:db/add "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909" :answer/id #uuid "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909"] [:db/add "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909" :answer/value "\frac{3}{4}"] [:db/ensure "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12" :answer-field/id #uuid "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12"] [:db/add "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12" :answer-field/choices "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909"] [:db/add "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12" :answer-field/correct "29129c0d-63a1-5fa5-b460-2ac6d96d7909"] [:db/ensure "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5" :question/id #uuid "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5"] [:db/add "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.

$$
\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 3 \cos{\left(4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

{{answer}}"] [:db/add "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then

$$
\frac{\mathrm{d}u}{\mathrm{d}x}=4.
$$

Transform both bounds:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\frac{3 \pi}{8}&\Longrightarrow u=\frac{3 \pi}{2}\\x=\frac{\pi}{2}&\Longrightarrow u=2 \pi\end{aligned}
$$

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{8}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}} 3 \cos{\left(4 x \right)}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi} \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \cos{\left(u \right)}\,\mathrm{d}u=\sin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Endpoint values: $\sin{\left(\frac{3 \pi}{2} \right)}=-1,\quad \sin{\left(2 \pi \right)}=0$.

Integrate and evaluate:

$$
\left[\frac{3 \sin{\left(u \right)}}{4}\right]_{\frac{3 \pi}{2}}^{2 \pi}=\left(0\right)-\left(- \frac{3}{4}\right).
$$

The answer is

$$
\frac{3}{4}.
$$"] [:db/add "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5" :question/answer-fields "a0b4fc06-a427-5181-8a39-38358b25ff12"] [:db/ensure "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186068915 :knowledge-point/questions "b3ba73e8-b32a-51d2-8418-65a2407941b5"] [:db/add "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72" :answer/id #uuid "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72"] [:db/add "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72" :answer/value "\frac{3}{2}"] [:db/ensure "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72" :answer/validate] [:db/add "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51" :answer-field/id #uuid "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51"] [:db/add "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51" :answer-field/choices "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72"] [:db/add "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51" :answer-field/correct "2cc87d46-26e5-5335-bed4-43c798e56f72"] [:db/ensure "916ef59f-170f-5229-bd63-8912425b4d51" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "e7a0f050-2946-58fd-95f9-73a790b95c11" :question/id #uuid "e7a0f050-2946-58fd-95f9-73a790b95c11"] [:db/add "e7a0f050-2946-58fd-95f9-73a790b95c11" :question/problem "Evaluate exactly.
